title: A sound's waveform grows and shrinks with its fades and level
goal: On the timeline, a sound's waveform stays full height when you fade it in or out or turn it down, so the drawing does not show what you will hear. The mock draws the waveform scaled by the level and the fades, so a fade-in visibly rises out of nothing. Draw it that way.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-audio.html ~506, `var h=samp[i]*levelAt(tr,t)*42;` (level x fade x duck). App: Sources/Photonz/ClipPiecesBar.swift ~335-347 passes only gainDB: soundLevel?.clipGainDB to SoundWaveform (Sources/Photonz/SoundLane.swift ~23-48), so fades and level points never reach the drawing. Put the level-at-time sum in PhotonzCore (AudioLevel already holds the points and fades; TDD the per-column scale), and have SoundWaveform take a per-column multiplier rather than one gain. Keep the hairline floor for silence. Duck is out of scope (music-dips-under-the-speech-by-itself waits on a card). Found by the manager pass's mock comparison, 2026-10-07; no task covered it (searched waveform, waveform fade, waveform level, with --all).
acceptance: A sound segment with a one second fade-in draws its waveform rising from a hairline at the start to full height at the end of the fade, and the same in reverse for a fade-out
Dragging the level line down shrinks the waveform with it while you drag, and level points between two values scale the drawing between them
Muting or soloing the track changes nothing about the drawing (only level and fades do), and a picture clip still draws no waveform

Try path at Next defaults: open the talk sample, drag the fade handle at the start of its sound to one second, drag the level line down, and the waveform follows. A walk photographs it and the audit puts it beside video-audio.html's lanes; audit written under queue/audits/
